mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE deleted=0) userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE deleted=0) activityCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0) signupCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_review WHERE deleted=0) reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{today}) todayUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{today}) todayActivities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{today}) todaySignups, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_review WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{today}) todayReviews

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') label, COUNT(*) value FROM useractivityactivity_signupactivity_review WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d')

choose.when: SELECT status label,COUNT(*) value FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY status
SELECT status label,COUNT(*) value FROM activity WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(category,''),'未分类') label,COUNT(*) value FROM activity WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY category
SELECT CASE WHEN credit_score<80 THEN 'ABNORMAL' WHEN credit_score<100 THEN '80-99' WHEN credit_score<120 THEN '100-119' ELSE '120+' END label,COUNT(*) value FROM user WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY label
choose.otherwise: SELECT CAST(rating AS CHAR) label,COUNT(*) value FROM activity_review WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY rating

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(status IN ('APPROVED','PROMOTED','COMPLETED'))*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end}),0) signupSuccessRate, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(approved_count*100.0/NULLIF(max_participants,0)) FROM activity WHERE deleted=0 AND status<>'CANCELLED' AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end}),0) averageParticipationRate, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rating) FROM activity_review WHERE deleted=0 AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end}),0) averageRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_waitlist WHERE deleted=0 AND status='WAITING' AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end}) waitlistCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0 AND status='CANCELLED' AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end}) exitCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE deleted=0 AND credit_score<80) abnormalCreditUserCount

SELECT a.id activityId,a.title, COALESCE(s.successful_signups,0) successfulSignups, COALESCE(w.waitlist_count,0) waitlistCount FROM activity a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id,COUNT(*) successful_signups FROM activity_signup WHERE deleted=0 AND status IN ('APPROVED','PROMOTED','COMPLETED') AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end} GROUP BY activity_id ) s ON s.activity_id=a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id,COUNT(*) waitlist_count FROM activity_waitlist WHERE deleted=0 AND status='WAITING' AND created_at>=#{start} AND created_at<#{end} GROUP BY activity_id ) w ON w.activity_id=a.id WHERE a.deleted=0 AND (s.successful_signups > 0 OR w.waitlist_count > 0) ORDER BY successfulSignups DESC,waitlistCount DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
